unactivatedCandidate.body:
This catalog was not activated. Public qualification did not complete because the interruption-test harness did not consistently reap its child process. Use the currently activated signed catalog from https://dotnetdev.kr/cbodotnet/. A corrected qualification will publish a new immutable catalog; these candidate bytes remain preserved.

Project-signed installation catalog with bounded freshness, revocation, source/producer pins and immutable SDK/tool hashes. All eight native OS/CPU qualification targets passed before this publication. Public bootstrap/native post-verification is recorded before feed activation. catalog.json is the schema2 feed; catalog-v1.json is the compatible schema1 feed. catalog-v1-bootstrap.json, catalog-v1-expired.json and catalog-v2-revoked.json are test-only qualification fixtures, not installation feeds. AUR publication remains deferred under issue10.
